name: Effective Range / Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension (affine)
details: Every finite binary class satisfies $\mathrm{E}(\mathcal H)\geq2\,\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}(\mathcal H)-1$, equivalently $\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}(\mathcal H)\leq\lceil\mathrm{E}(\mathcal H)/2\rceil$.
witness_verification: For the full cube on $n$ active coordinates, $\mathrm{E}=n$ and $\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}=\lceil n/2\rceil$, so the affine bound is attained for odd $n$ and is off by only one for even $n$.
proof: Each coordinate trace $\mathcal H_{\mid S}$ has effective range at most $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$. Applying the sharp no-clashing upper bound $\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H_{\mid S})\leq\lceil\mathrm E(\mathcal H)/2\rceil$ to every trace and maximizing over $S$ proves the claim.
proof_source: Corollary cor:effective-range-low-projected-nctd in the LaTeX survey.
